scope: Exact TextBottom effect-state restoration, not only its color
contract: BottomColor and BottomOpacity always make the Slate bottom attribute set, even for an unchanged color. Primary setters do not clear it.
Capture separate owning UObject color and Slate attribute baselines. Preserve unset/bound state as well as color, updating the baseline for genuine untinted native changes.
Restore UObject color by owning assignment and the complete Slate attribute through its borrowed native setter, under current subject/session/Slate-pair authority.
No memcpy of owners/delegates, raw flag patch or whole-widget synchronization. Attribute assignment requires a valid initialized destination; destruction releases owners but not storage.
verification: All windows are unique and instruction-complete in explicit imported programs; default entry windows and first 64 bytes match authenticated canonical disk. Older is import-only. No runtime invocation or rendered restoration qualification.

abi.end_text_slate_set_bottom_attribute: void(Slate* RCX, borrowed Attribute40* RDX); owns copy, does not consume input; native invalidation
abi.native_slate_color_attribute_assign: Attribute40* (initialized destination RCX, borrowed source RDX); retains color and clones/replaces delegate
abi.native_slate_color_attribute_destroy: void(Attribute40* RCX); releases delegate/color ownership without freeing caller storage
